content:
~ I thought JENISH meant unbeatable...
Then CA humbled me....

~ I never studied 10 hours a day...
But CA made me do it....

~ I never sacrificed my sleep for an exam...
But CA made me do it....

~ I never cancelled plans just to study...
But CA made me do it....

~ I never questioned myself this deeply...
But CA made me stronger....

~ I never believed in myself this much...
But CA taught me to....

~ CA didn't just test my knowledge.
It tested patience...,
discipline...,
resilience...,
and character....!

~ Some exams give you a degree....
And some gives you a different version of yourself....!

~ it didn't break me. It broke my ego..., rebuilt my mindset..., and introduced me to a version of myself I had never met before....!
